The '''Warlock''' was a title given to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] by [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial officers]]. [[Laurita Tohm]] knew of Vader by this moniker, and his reputation at the Imperial academy on [[Raithal/Legends|Raithal]], where it was rumored that Lord Vader killed hundreds of Imperials on a whim.
